sourceClauseReference.antecedentJudgment: The relative antecedent concerns protein diversity, not alternative splicing as a prerequisite of every selection process. The corrected full descriptions add the necessary inheritance/reproductive-success condition without discarding the explanatory operator.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Alternatives Spleißen für Proteinvielfalt erklären
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Explain Alternative Splicing for Protein Diversity
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den Beitrag alternativen Spleißens zur Proteinvielfalt bei Eukaryoten erklären und die Bedeutung dieser Vielfalt für Selektionsprozesse in der Evolution einordnen, wenn relevante Unterschiede erblich sind und den Fortpflanzungserfolg beeinflussen.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the contribution of alternative splicing to protein diversity in eukaryotes and contextualize the significance of this diversity for evolutionary selection processes when relevant differences are heritable and affect reproductive success.

perTargetedGoalJudgments.ownIndependentScientificAndFidelityReaso: Both new full DE/EN descriptions explicitly make alternative splicing a contribution to protein diversity. This diversity, not splicing itself as a universal necessity, is related to selection only when relevant differences are inherited and affect reproductive success. The original official EA2.4 antecedent is Proteinvielfalt. Both explaining splicing and contextualizing its evolutionary relevance remain. The same two whole bilingual cases distinguish compatible isoforms, frame/stop failure, inherited R/r regulation/differential reproduction, temporary somatic plasticity and equal-success wet-habitat counterevidence. The conditional corrected goal now agrees with those existing scientifically valid tasks, worked answers and transfers.
ownThreeConcreteCriterionJudgments: E1–E2–E4 versus E1–E3–E4 under complete compatible codons gives distinct supplied domains without an extra gene.
Four-nucleotide exon omission/early stop does not guarantee a stable functional protein; sequence/stability/function evidence is needed.

Inherited R/r regulation with4vs2 supplied reproductive success differs from temporary temperature response; equal wet-habitat success does not imply selective advantage merely from remaining protein diversity.
perTargetedGoalJudgments.sourceScopeAndAtomarityObservation: The same single LK molecular explanation/variation competence is retained. This is not a new course/stage/content role. Its current normal A/M/D/P/V bindings still require the appropriate actual successor frame.
perTargetedGoalJudgments.noNewMemoryRequirementObservation: These remain explanatory/model/data-transfer skills. An unchanged kind classification is not an ordinary current A/M approval or a memory-card decision by hash.

This now matches the unchanged full EN material and the gamete-to-zygote product mechanism. The actual duplicate German profile taskDemand contains that same correction. I reread both whole bilingual cases and all worked/fresh responses: the9 genotypes, complete dominance9:3:3:1, AaBb×aabb1:1:1:1, incomplete dominance1:2:1, stated linked45/45/5/5 testcross and fresh Ccdd×ccDd ccdd25% remain correct under their distinct assumptions.
ownThreeConcreteCriterionJudgments: Each gamete has one allele per locus; each parent has four possible equally likely types in the independent-locus model.
Genotype and phenotype products depend on the explicitly given dominance/independence/survival assumptions; observed samples need not exactly match probability.
The linked-gamete counterexample and incomplete/codominance cases prevent blind imposition of3:1/9:3:3:1 or1:1:1:1 on every crossing.
